sample_unit: test cases (HECKTOR 2022 PET/CT), each with 36 perturbed variants

links.outcome: Segmentation Dice and clinician-rated usability under synthetic image perturbations (noise, blur, ghosting, bias-field, spike, motion)
links.effect: Baseline Dice 0.766 (GTVp) and 0.698 (GTVn); performance dropped significantly under spike noise and bias-field, especially GTVn; usability for GTVn fell to 27.9% under severe perturbations vs 77.8% for GTVp.
links.quote: Performance dropped significantly under spike noise and bias-field artifacts, especially for GTVn.

unlisted_practices: Targeted data augmentation to improve robustness to image artifacts
Correlating radiomic features with robustness degradation to identify vulnerable cases

screen.reason: The study tests the robustness and clinical usability of an imaging segmentation model using synthetic perturbations/stress-testing and clinician grading under corrupted imaging conditions.
